description:
Hey! We are 3rd-year Engineering students interested in AI/ML, healthcare tech, robotics, and innovation. We have experience with Python, Java, frontend development, project building, research, and pitching ideas.
We are looking for passionate teammates skilled in AI/ML, backend development, UI/UX, robotics, and hardware. We value creativity, teamwork, and people who are ready to learn and build something impactful together.
Let's innovate, build, and win!
